ip_top_stories.title: Sony Copyright Suit Survives AI Music Generator's Dismissal Bid
ip_top_stories.summary: A court has allowed Sony's copyright infringement suit against an AI music generator to proceed, rejecting the defendant's motion to dismiss. The case is among the growing body of litigation testing whether AI-generated or AI-assisted music products infringe existing copyrights. This ruling signals that DMCA claims against AI music platforms have legal traction.

ip_top_stories.title: AI Music Generator Can't Duck DMCA Claim
ip_top_stories.summary: A court has ruled that an AI music generator cannot escape a DMCA copyright claim, in a decision that reinforces the applicability of existing copyright law to AI music tools. The ruling is significant for rights holders pursuing infringement actions against AI audio platforms.

ip_top_stories.title: Copyright owners v AI developers: the emerging trends
ip_top_stories.summary: An analysis of the key emerging legal trends in disputes between copyright owners and AI developers, covering training data litigation, fair use arguments, and licensing negotiations. The piece maps the evolving landscape as courts and legislators begin to shape the boundaries of AI and copyright law.

ip_top_stories.title: EU copyright law roundup – first trimester of 2026
ip_top_stories.summary: A comprehensive roundup from IPKat covering EU copyright law developments in the first three months of 2026, including updates relevant to AI and copyright. The piece tracks legislative and judicial activity across European jurisdictions affecting rights holders and AI developers.

ip_top_stories.title: Monkey selfie from 15 years ago accidentally sets precedent for AI copyright dispute
ip_top_stories.summary: The decade-old Naruto v. Slater monkey selfie case, which established that non-human authors cannot hold copyright, is now being cited in AI copyright disputes over machine-generated works. Legal commentators note the precedent creates significant obstacles for claims of copyright ownership in purely AI-generated content.

ip_further_links.title: Is the government's stance on AI copyright holding back the UK tech scene?
ip_further_links.summary: An examination of whether the UK government's current position on AI and copyright law is creating uncertainty that disadvantages the domestic technology sector.

ip_further_links.title: AI Startups Have These Copyright Lawyers on Speed Dial
ip_further_links.summary: A look at the specialist copyright attorneys increasingly retained by AI companies to navigate training data disputes and licensing negotiations.

ip_further_links.title: Analysing China's stricter examination standards for AI-related patent applications
ip_further_links.summary: An analysis of China's tightened patent examination criteria for AI-related inventions and what this means for applicants seeking protection in that jurisdiction.

ip_further_links.title: Delhi HC Directs Time-Bound Decision on AI Generated Artwork Copyright Plea
ip_further_links.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed authorities to reach a time-bound decision on a petition seeking copyright protection for AI-generated artwork, adding to global judicial scrutiny of machine authorship.

ip_further_links.title: Anthropic Code Crisis Creates Copyright Contradiction
ip_further_links.summary: An analysis of the copyright contradictions arising from Anthropic's handling of code generated by its AI models, raising questions about ownership and liability.

ip_further_links.title: AI Makes Securing Copyright Protection for Software Code Tricky Guide
ip_further_links.summary: A legal guide examining the difficulties in obtaining copyright protection for software code produced with AI assistance, given unresolved questions about authorship and human contribution.

ip_further_links.title: AI-generated content should be clearly labelled to help people spot fakes, committee says
ip_further_links.summary: A parliamentary or regulatory committee has recommended mandatory labelling of AI-generated content to enable audiences to identify synthetic media, according to The Globe and Mail.

ip_further_links.title: AI in the patent industry: Don't believe the hype. Believe the data.
ip_further_links.summary: An IPKat post presenting data-driven analysis of AI's actual impact on the patent industry, countering overstated claims about AI's transformative role in patent prosecution and examination.

ip_further_links.title: Bologna Children's Book Fair 2026: AI Takes Center Stage
ip_further_links.summary: Publishers Weekly reports that AI in publishing was a dominant theme at the 2026 Bologna Children's Book Fair, with discussions spanning creative tools, rights concerns, and industry adaptation.

ip_further_links.title: Mexico's New AI Law Could Hinder USMCA Review, Warns AMITI
ip_further_links.summary: Mexico's technology industry association AMITI has warned that the country's new AI legislation could complicate the upcoming USMCA trade agreement review, with IP provisions among the concerns raised.
